high_level_description: Chapultepec Castle on top of its wooded hill in Mexico City, seen from below through the trees of the park, with a boating lake in the foreground.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Mexico City; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright high-altitude sunlight with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A clear blue sky over a forested hill.

elements.desc: A pale neoclassical castle with terraces, arches and a small round tower on top of a hill.
Thick green forest of tall cypress and ash trees on the hill.
A calm lake with small rowing boats and families.
A young man in a hoodie holding a leaflet and pointing up at the castle.
